title: Variance-driven golden-set curation & access workflow for eval gating
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: We need an operationally-safe, auditable workflow for managing golden prompt/answer bundles that are used to detect quality regressions when models or serving configs change. Current practices have ad-hoc sets, inconsistent ownership, and lack automated re-evals tied to model/config commits.

Goal: Define a variance-driven curation and access workflow that: (1) creates immutable, signed golden snapshots with metadata; (2) maintains role-based access and steward approvals; (3) automatically re-evaluates affected golden sets on model/config changes; (4) computes delta metrics and triggers gated rollouts or alerts when regressions exceed thresholds; and (5) provides an audit trail and rollback path for releases.

Scope: This ticket covers the product workflow, metadata model for golden bundles, approval gates, diff thresholds and policy defaults, and the integration touchpoints with CI, runtime gating, and Console observability. Implementation details for serving runtime and low-level infra will be tracked in engineering sub-tasks.

Non-goals: Building a new eval engine or major UI redesigns. This ticket assumes existing eval runner and Console primitives will be reused.
acceptance_criteria: A metadata schema is defined for golden bundles (owner, steward, signer, version, creation_hash, linked_prompt_ids, applicability rules, retention policy) and reviewed by Security and Applied ML
A lightweight curator workflow is documented: create -> sign snapshot -> assign steward -> optional peer review -> publish to registry with access tiers

Automatic re-eval trigger spec: when a model binary, quantization profile, or serving config changes, the system enumerates impacted golden bundles and schedules re-evals within 1 hour of the CI event
Delta threshold rules are specified: per-metric thresholds (e.g., accuracy drop, mean-token surprisal, hallucination-rate) and an aggregated variance score used to gate rollouts
Console shows a dedicated Golden Bundle page with version history, signer information, linked PRs, latest eval results and a one-click rollback to a previous bundle for rollouts that used the bundle
RBAC matrix for bundle actions (create, sign, review, publish, revoke) is defined and mapped to existing SSO groups
Security review sign-off documented and a key-rotation plan for signing keys exists
Integration points are listed (CI hooks, model catalog, runtime rollout policies) and at least one end-to-end smoke test is defined
updates: 2026-02-20: Ticket created during Eval Quality strategy sync. Captured initial problems and stakeholders (Applied ML, Runtime, Console, Security).
2026-02-25: Draft metadata schema uploaded to Confluence and shared with Applied ML for feedback. Noted requirement for immutable hash and signer info.
2026-03-02: Design review with Console team. Agreed to reuse existing version history UI patterns; flagged need for an 'impact preview' showing which models/configs reference a bundle.
2026-03-05: Security requested HSM/KMS integration for signing; marked security_review_required=true and added key-rotation doc to links. Blocking until infra estimates received.

2026-03-10: Scoped automatic re-eval trigger: CI webhook on model/catalog change -> job schedules evals and computes per-metric variance; if variance_score > policy threshold, create a regression alert and pause A/B rollout. Engineering subtask created to instrument eval runner to emit standardized metrics.
notes_on_implementation: Key design decisions to validate with Engineering: (1) signer model - short-lived ephemeral signer vs long-lived organizational signer; (2) storage for immutable bundles - object store with content-addressable keys; (3) re-eval capacity - soft quota to avoid expensive mass re-evals during catalog churn; (4) policy defaults - conservative thresholds for P0 customers and more lenient for internal experiments. Will propose a staged rollout: internal -> beta customers -> GA.
next_steps: Gather Applied ML feedback on suggested per-metric variance calculations and create a reference implementation notebook
Work with Security to finalize signing key approach and add infra estimate to dependent ENG ticket
Define Console wireframes for Golden Bundle page and impact preview (design task to follow)
Create ENG sub-issues to: implement registry API, add CI webhook consumer, and expose eval metrics to Console
